descriptionChirho: The act or practice of divination, especially as practiced by foreign nations (Balaam) or forbidden in Israel; includes the cognate accusative construction 'one who practices divination' (Dt 18:10) and 'divination fees' (Nu 22:7).
A divinely-guided decision or authoritative pronouncement, used in a positive sense of the king's lips as an oracle (Pr 16:10).
